lines.text: Hiram king of Tyre sends envoys to Solomon, who asks him to cut cedars of Lebanon for the LORD's house.
Hiram rejoices and promises to haul the logs from Lebanon to the Sea and float them as rafts.
Solomon sends Hiram 20,000 cors of barley and 20,000 baths of pure olive oil, and they make a treaty.
Solomon conscripts 30,000 men and sends them to Lebanon in monthly shifts of 10,000, with Adoniram in charge.
Solomon has 70,000 porters, 80,000 stonecutters and 3,600 foremen, and the king commands large, costly stones for the temple foundation.
